messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up: Acme renewal in 30 days. CS wants to offer a blended 12mo retainer + usage commit instead of straight uplift. Can pricing confirm feasibility and ARR impact? Also can Deal Desk accept limited POC credits applied against Q1 to cover their current evaluation?

lexi_pricing: Yes we can structure a retainer+usage blend. Common patterns: (1) base retainer covering steady-state + discounted overage, (2) minimum monthly token commit with roll-up credits, or (3) refundable retainer credited over first quarters. Need current run-rate and POC credit amount to model.

alex_sales: Their trailing 6mo average ~120M tokens/month. POC currently at ~15M tokens, ends in ~3 weeks. They want POC credit applied to Q1 invoice.

jamal_se: SE note: POC blocked by a KMS/key rotation question and they asked for a 1000 RPS performance window. Sara, can security approve a limited-scope sandbox while legal finalizes BYOK?

sara_security: We can provision a sandbox with Redwood-managed keys to keep POC moving. BYOK requires MSA addendum and attestation; timeline ~45 days post-sign. We should capture sandbox terms in an Acknowledgement email and limit data scope.

maria_csm: Customer prefers 12mo with quarterly usage reconciliations and an opt-out at month 9 with a small termination fee. Also wants price protection if model infra cost drops.

lexi_pricing: Pricing proposals: A) 12mo retainer $100k/mo covering ~40% baseline + usage at 70% list; B) Commit: annual commit = 1.1x run-rate with 10% commit discount; C) Hybrid refundable retainer $120k credited $60k Q1/$60k Q2 + annual usage commit $1.5M at 15% off list. For POC credits: Deal Desk will accept a capped credit applied to Q1 if <=5% of ARR and documented in SOW.

deal-desk-bot: Created DD-7421. Attach SOW, POC credit amount, and approval rationale.

alex_sales: Lexi — please upload the one-page summary with numbers for option C (refundable retainer credited over Q1/Q2) and ARR mapping. Also need a short BYOK timeline blurb for legal.

lexi_pricing: Example math: trailing annualized run-rate ~$1.8M. Option C: refundable retainer $120k (credited $60k Q1, $60k Q2). Annual committed usage $1.5M at 15% discount -> net effective ARR year1 = $1.5M. Customer reduces upfront cash; we secure commit. BYOK blurb: "POC may run on Redwood-managed keys; BYOK onboarding targeted within 45 days post-signature and captured in an MSA addendum."

jamal_se: For the 1000 RPS test we can schedule a 1-hour dedicated load window on a reserved pool. I'll open an eng-infra ticket to reserve capacity and require a runbook for the test.

maria_csm: I'll request the sandbox acknowledgement email from the customer and confirm they accept refundable retainer credited over two quarters plus the month-9 opt-out with termination fee.

sara_security: I'll prepare the KMS/BYOK answer for the security questionnaire and a short note for legal about the temporary-key sandbox conditions.

alex_sales: Plan: Lexi uploads pricing sheet to DD-7421, Maria secures sandbox ack, Jamal files infra ticket for the load test, Sara prepares BYOK/legal blurb. Loop in Sales Ops if termination fee or price-protection clauses look non-standard. :thumbsup:
